kind: engineering acceptance check of the kinase residue-role mapping helper (python/topofold_inputs/kinase_roles.py) on the frozen KIN-ROB-1 panel; no state labels, no classification, no biological claim
not_blind: The helper was written after KIN-ROB-1 and KIN-ROB-1a were run, and its unit tests use a fixture derived from the same panel. This is a regression and acceptance check against recorded outputs, not an independent test of the method.

inputs_read_only.structures_and_sequences: the KIN-ROB-1 downloads (git-ignored); SHA-256 must equal KIN-ROB-1_results.json inputs

reference_declaration: UniProt canonical sequence of each accession as downloaded by KIN-ROB-1, isoform stated as '<accession>-1'
anchors: beta3_Lys, alphaC_Glu, DFG_Asp from the spec, HRD_H = XHRD + 1; the other six roles are derived by the helper

frozen_spec.numbering: reference, reference_minus_label = 0 (the KIN-ROB-1 spec labels its positions as UniProt)
frozen_spec.expected: accepted for 8 chains; refused for 1ATP E (literature numbering labelled as UniProt)

pka_kin_rob_1a.numbering: reference, 0, positions from the KIN-ROB-1a spec

pka_literature_declared.numbering: reference, reference_minus_label = +1 stated explicitly, positions from the KIN-ROB-1 spec

structure_author.numbering: structure_author; anchors are the author residues used by KIN-ROB-1 (KIN-ROB-1a for 1ATP E)

pka_structure_author_original.numbering: structure_author; anchors are the author residues the failed KIN-ROB-1 run used (71, 90, 163, 183)

checks.M2_reference_positions: accepted cases: the ten derived role positions equal the frozen spec positions (KIN-ROB-1a for 1ATP E)
checks.M3_structure_residues: accepted cases: mapped author residues equal those of KIN-ROB-1 (KIN-ROB-1a for 1ATP E); roles the helper reports unobserved equal the residues KIN-ROB-1 reported as residue_not_found
checks.M4_descriptors: accepted cases: kinase_descriptors on extract_atoms(mapping.atom_request(), altloc='blank_then_A') equal the recorded KIN-ROB-1 (1a) descriptors exactly; NaN where the record has null
checks.M5_observed_chain: observed_chain (MDAnalysis) equals the independent fixed-column parse in the committed fixture for every chain
checks.M6_refusal_content: refused 1ATP E cases: each anchor motif mismatch is named; for the reference-numbering case the diagnostic reports offset d = +1 and the mapping is not returned
checks.M7_frozen_artifacts_and_code: SHA-256 of ca_adapter.py, atom_adapter.py and kinase_geometry.py equal the KIN-ROB-1 freeze; KIN-ROB-1 and KIN-ROB-1a spec, runner and result files equal their values at this freeze

permitted_interpretation: Engineering evidence that the helper reproduces the recorded role residues and descriptor values on these 9 chains, refuses the original PKA specification and accepts correctly declared PKA mappings. No general claim about other kinases, numbering schemes or structures.
